_contract: The Phase-A preflight's stage topology: which stages exist, which block, what each produces and why they are ordered so. EXPERIMENT INSTANCE DATA that used to sit in src/aadistill. Transcribed without edit, so plan_hash is unchanged. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.

stages.name: runtime attestation
stages.purpose: pin what everything else will be measured and trained under, before any of it happens
produces: input artifact hashes (canonical init, pack, suite, battery)
stop_conditions: any input artifact hash mismatches its pin
trainer source file missing from the declared set
attested trainer digest or runtime contradicts a preregistered value -> protocol drift, STOP

stages.name: cheap machine gates
stages.purpose: find out whether this machine and runtime are usable at all
produces: peak GPU resident memory on the widest operator
stop_conditions: evaluator repeatability range >= declared epsilon -> conservative_review_gate fires, Phase A blocked, STOP
peak resident memory > 40 GiB on an L40S -> hardware plan wrong, STOP
disk throughput implies the working set is not feasible -> STOP

stages.name: permanent canonical controls
stages.purpose: produce the two matched control probes that Phase A will reuse at rung 2
stop_conditions: a run's protocol fingerprint differs from the Stage-0 ATTESTED protocol hash (not the preregistered object, which still carries runtime_digest: null)
a run's protocol is not materialized
step time diverges from the priced 4.15 s/step by more than 25%

stages.name: control characterization
stages.purpose: materialize the frozen threshold formulas from control data only
produces: pooled_counts@v2 aggregate + per-seed counts and rates
stop_conditions: capability schema validation fails -> scoring defect, STOP
